requirements.quote:
When a PTO timer expires, a sender MUST send at least one ack-
   eliciting packet in the packet number space as a probe.
requirements.condition: A sender's PTO timer expires for a packet number space.
requirements.required_behavior: The sender sends at least one ack-eliciting packet as a probe in the packet number space for which the PTO timer expired.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Sending no ack-eliciting probe in the packet number space whose PTO timer expired.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A PTO-expiration trace can identify the expired packet number space and count ack-eliciting probes sent in that space.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint
   MAY send up to two full-sized datagrams containing ack-eliciting
   packets
requirements.condition: An endpoint exercises the optional full-sized-datagram probe strategy on PTO expiration.
requirements.required_behavior: The optional probe transmission consists of no more than two full-sized datagrams.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Sending more than two full-sized datagrams under this stated PTO probe option.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A PTO send event exposes the number and size class of datagrams emitted by this strategy.

requirements.quote: All probe packets sent on a PTO MUST be ack-eliciting.
requirements.condition: A packet is sent as a probe on a PTO.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Sending a non-ack-eliciting packet as a PTO probe.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet frames can be inspected to determine whether every PTO probe is ack-eliciting.

requirements.quote:
In addition to sending data in the packet number space for which the
   timer expired, the sender SHOULD send ack-eliciting packets from
   other packet number spaces with in-flight data
requirements.condition: A PTO timer expires and packet number spaces other than the expired space contain in-flight data.
requirements.required_behavior: In addition to data in the expired packet number space, the sender sends ack-eliciting packets from the other packet number spaces that have in-flight data.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Without a justified exception, probing only the expired packet number space while another packet number space has in-flight data.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: The sender's in-flight state and the packet number space of each emitted probe are observable at PTO expiration.

requirements.quote:
the sender SHOULD send ack-eliciting packets from
   other packet number spaces with in-flight data, coalescing packets if
   possible.
requirements.condition: A sender sends PTO probe packets from multiple packet number spaces and packet coalescing is possible.
requirements.required_behavior: The sender coalesces the packets when possible.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Without a justified exception, emitting separately datagrammable packets when they could have been coalesced.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet construction can show whether packets from the relevant spaces were coalesced when size and key constraints permitted it.

requirements.quote:
If the sender wants to elicit a faster acknowledgment on PTO, it can
   skip a packet number to eliminate the acknowledgment delay.
requirements.condition: A sender wants to elicit a faster acknowledgment on PTO.
requirements.required_behavior: The text describes skipping a packet number as a possible technique.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: No behavior is forbidden by this non-normative possibility statement.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet numbers are observable, but the word 'can' provides neither an implementation obligation nor a bounded conformance rule.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint SHOULD include new data in packets that are sent on PTO
   expiration.
requirements.condition: An endpoint sends packets on PTO expiration and has new data available to send.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint includes new data in the packets sent on PTO expiration.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Without a justified exception, sending PTO packets with no new data when new data is available.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation's send queue and probe contents can establish whether available new data was included.

requirements.quote:
Previously sent data MAY be sent if no new data can be
   sent.
requirements.condition: No new data can be sent on PTO expiration.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint is permitted, but not required, to send previously sent data.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: No behavior is forbidden; this clause authorizes an optional fallback.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A trace can classify previously sent data used under the no-new-data condition as an expressly permitted PTO payload choice.

requirements.quote:
Implementations MAY use alternative strategies for determining
   the content of probe packets, including sending new or retransmitted
   data based on the application's priorities.
requirements.condition: An implementation selects the contents of probe packets.
requirements.required_behavior: The text permits unspecified alternative content-selection strategies.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: No concrete behavior is forbidden by this open-ended permission.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: The permission is open-ended and supplies no bounded invariant against which a strategy can be judged.

requirements.quote:
When there is no data to send, the sender SHOULD send
   a PING or other ack-eliciting frame in a single packet, rearming the
   PTO timer.
requirements.condition: The sender has no new or previously sent data to send when probing after PTO expiration.
requirements.required_behavior: The sender sends a PING frame or another ack-eliciting frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Without a justified exception, sending no ack-eliciting frame when no data is available for the PTO probe.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: The absence of sendable data and the frame types in the fallback probe are observable.

requirements.quote:
the sender SHOULD send
   a PING or other ack-eliciting frame in a single packet
requirements.condition: The sender uses the recommended no-data PTO fallback.
requirements.required_behavior: The PING or other ack-eliciting fallback frame is sent in one packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Splitting the no-data fallback probe across multiple packets.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet construction directly shows how many packets carry the fallback frame or frames.

requirements.condition: The sender emits the recommended single-packet PING or other ack-eliciting fallback because no data is available.
requirements.required_behavior: The sender rearms the PTO timer after sending the fallback probe.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leaving the PTO timer unarmed after sending the fallback probe.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Timer state immediately after the fallback send can be inspected to confirm that the PTO timer was rearmed.

requirements.quote:
Alternatively, instead of sending an ack-eliciting packet, the sender
   MAY mark any packets still in flight as lost.
requirements.condition: The sender chooses the stated alternative to sending an ack-eliciting packet for the no-data PTO case.
requirements.required_behavior: The sender may select packets that are still in flight and mark them as lost instead of sending an ack-eliciting packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Under this alternative, marking as lost a packet that is not still in flight, or both relying on the alternative and sending the substituted ack-eliciting packet.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet recovery state can show whether selected packets were in flight, were transitioned to lost, and replaced the additional probe send.

requirements.condition: PTO periods occur consecutively without recovery.
requirements.required_behavior: The duration of consecutive PTO periods grows exponentially.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using constant or merely linear growth for consecutive PTO periods.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Recorded PTO deadlines and durations across consecutive expirations reveal whether the series grows exponentially.

requirements.quote:
When the PTO timer expires multiple times and new data cannot be
   sent, implementations must choose between sending the same payload
   every time or sending different payloads.
requirements.condition: The PTO timer expires multiple times and new data cannot be sent.
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation selects payloads for repeated sends, whether the same payload or different payloads.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: No concrete payload choice is forbidden by the stated alternatives.
requirements.error_behavior: No explicit error behavior is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Although payload equality can be observed, the sentence exhausts the possible choices without imposing a discriminating conformance requirement.
